title: Git Flow Command Center
summary: Branch, commit, review, merge, release — with prompts your agents can run without re-explaining your workflow.

bindings.title: Branch & PR Hygiene
appliesWhen: Opening or updating a pull request
bindings.instructions: Use feature/<ticket>-<slug> branch names. Keep commits scoped to one logical change with an imperative summary line. PR descriptions must include a one-line "why" and a manual test note.
constraints: Do not squash commits that mix unrelated changes into one message.
verification: Every PR description has a test plan section before merge.

bindings.title: Release Notes From Commits
bindings.instructions: Group commits by feature, fix, and chore. Only describe behavior actually present in the diff. Flag breaking changes in a separate section at the top.
constraints: Do not summarize a commit message you cannot trace to a diff.
verification: Every bullet references a real commit hash.

bindings.title: Test-First Bug Fix Workflow
appliesWhen: Fixing a reported bug or failing test
doesNotApplyWhen: Greenfield feature work with no failing test yet
bindings.instructions: Reproduce the failure with a test before editing code. Write the smallest fix that makes the test pass. Run the full nearby test suite before declaring success, and report failures honestly.
constraints: Do not touch unrelated files while fixing a scoped bug.
verification: Failing test existed before the fix and passes after it.
